root: ^“Can you remind me how much? I remember the last time you chose to go out with your friend's birthday even though that night will also be the night before I left overseas.”
^“So… Are you ready to talk again?”
^I’m really sorry, sayang… I was being hurtful to you. I really didn’t want to… I see that you were just trying to communicate what you need."
^"Yeah, it’s okay. I didn’t need you to be perfect. I’m not either. And I’m sorry I hurt you too."
^"I love you. I want to learn to be a better partner to you…"
^"It’s not just you, Nes. A relationship is between two people.  I’ll also learn how to be happy for you."

BRANCH2: ^“I didn’t end up going, though, right? Because you told me that you needed me.”
^“Yeah… But if I didn’t say it would you still have gone?”
^“Van, I love you very much, and I’m sorry I was not sensitive to your feelings at that time. I really just want to make you comfortable. It was never my intention to hurt you.”
^“Mmhm, and I appreciate you telling me about this. We can’t do anything if we don’t know what the problem is right?”
^“Nes… Thank you for being patient with me. I’m sorry I got emotional back there. I know you’re tired too…”
^“I’m sorry if I hurt you too… I just want to be a good partner to you.”
OUTRO: ^"You know you’re precious to me, right?"
^"You know, binary stars get brighter when they’re together. Even more than single ones."
^"You won’t leave me alone like the sun?"
^"Hehe, it’s okay, it’s been a long day. Let’s talk about it tomorrow, okay?"
